lessonGrammar.name: 非限制性定语从句 which
lessonGrammar.note: which 引导非限制性定语从句,补充说明 consultation,与主干用逗号隔开。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The thesis consultation, which my professor may hold every Friday, may last an hour, and each visit may cost me a whole day of preparation.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 论文咨询,我的教授也许每周五进行,可能持续一个小时,而每一次拜访都可能让我花上一整天的准备时间。

lessonGrammar.name: 双宾语 cost me a day
lessonGrammar.note: cost 后接「间接宾语(人)+直接宾语(时间)」,表示「花费某人…」。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The thesis consultation, which my professor may hold every Friday, may last an hour, and each visit may cost me a whole day of preparation.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 论文咨询,我的教授也许每周五进行,可能持续一个小时,而每一次拜访都可能让我花上一整天的准备时间。

lessonGrammar.name: 长难句拆解
lessonGrammar.note: 本句是典型的插入式长句:先读主干 The thesis consultation may last an hour,再读被逗号隔开的从句。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The thesis consultation, which my professor may hold every Friday, may last an hour, and each visit may cost me a whole day of preparation.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 论文咨询,我的教授也许每周五进行,可能持续一个小时,而每一次拜访都可能让我花上一整天的准备时间。

lessonGrammar.name: 表语从句 that
lessonGrammar.note: that 引导表语从句,说明 lesson 的内容。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: She is a firm guide, and her first lesson is that a sane topic is half the battle, while a broad interest must find one narrow focus.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 她是一位坚定的引路人,她的第一课是:明智的选题等于成功了一半,而宽泛的兴趣必须找到一个狭窄的焦点。

lessonGrammar.name: while 对比连接词
lessonGrammar.note: while 连接两个分句,表示对照:「而…」。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: She is a firm guide, and her first lesson is that a sane topic is half the battle, while a broad interest must find one narrow focus.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 她是一位坚定的引路人,她的第一课是:明智的选题等于成功了一半,而宽泛的兴趣必须找到一个狭窄的焦点。
